description: This file defines the Template class within the Opencart system library, responsible for managing template rendering through different adaptors. It includes methods for constructing the object with a specified adaptor, adding paths, and rendering templates.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Manages template rendering via adaptors, allowing path addition and rendering of templates with given data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template object with specified adaptor class, throws exception if class does not exist.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Delegates the addition of a directory path within the adaptor.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Delegates rendering of a template file with data and optional code, returning the rendered string.
